sentences.text: Peking University -LRB- abbreviated PKU and colloquially known in Chinese as Běidà 北大 Chinese : 北京大学 , pinyin : Běijīng Dàxué -RRB- , is a major Chinese research university located in Beijing and a member of the C9 League .	Beijing	Beijing	C9	C9 League	Chinese	Chinese language	pinyin	pinyin	research university	research university	C9 League	C9 League

It is the first modern national university established in China , founded as the Imperial University of Peking in 1898 as a replacement of the ancient Taixue or Guozijian , or Imperial Academy .	China	China	Taixue	Taixue	Guozijian	Guozijian
It also served as the highest administration for education -LRB- ministry of education -RRB- in China at the beginning of its founding .	China	China
By 1920 , it had become a center for progressive thought .
Peking University is consistently ranked as the top higher learning institution in mainland China .	China	China	mainland China	mainland China

In addition to academics , Peking University is especially renowned for its campus grounds , and the beauty of its traditional Chinese architecture .	Chinese	Chinese language	Chinese architecture	Chinese architecture

Throughout its history , the university has educated and hosted many prominent modern Chinese thinkers , including figures such as : Mao Zedong , Lu Xun , Gu Hongming , Mao Dun , Li Dazhao , and Chen Duxiu .	Chinese	Chinese language	Mao Zedong	Mao Zedong	Lu Xun	Lu Xun	Gu Hongming	Gu Hongming	Mao Dun	Mao Dun	Li Dazhao	Li Dazhao	Chen Duxiu	Chen Duxiu

Peking University was influential in the birth of China 's New Culture Movement , May Fourth Movement , the Tiananmen Square protest of 1989 and many other significant events .
